scope: All 483 local SVGs were rasterized and passed through the runtime alpha-to-silhouette fallback. This verifies nonempty geometry input coverage, not the historical accuracy of inferred depth or all-device performance.
sourcePlacement: Proportional fit within 80% of the 900×1000 paper, centered; matches the default original-outline placement.
registration: Original SVG feature positions were visually checked against the six local pilot photographs. Brow/nose/mouth depth remains a contemporary design inference.
preferredSixSourceSilhouettes: At runtime, the six original-template silhouettes take priority when present, retaining their reviewed outlines and holes. This broad-coverage report tests the fallback on all 483 sources, including those six.
unknownSourceBehavior: Sources without registered landmarks receive only a shallow source-shaped relief; no eyes or noses are invented.
freeDrawingBehavior: Works without a base outline or template use a clearly labelled generic blank mask shell.
unitChecks: node tests/model-mask.test.cjs checks source notches/ornaments, closed rims, opposite back winding, 0.09 shell thickness, planar proportional UVs, transform registration, depth separation, small-gap closure, and empty-mask rejection.
limitations: Not original-object scans, verified wearable dimensions, or print-ready models.
Raster-derived source silhouettes approximate fine line gaps and may fill enclosed decorative holes in the fallback path.
Mobile Safari was not measured on physical hardware by the agent.
